evaluations.evidence: As a moderator, I want to create a new game
evaluations.rationale: Unique action (creating a game) and actor (moderator); no other story duplicates this requirement.

evaluations.evidence: invite estimators by giving them a URL
evaluations.rationale: Specific invitation mechanism (URL) and purpose; no other story expresses the identical requirement.

evaluations.evidence: start a round by entering an item in a single multi-line text field
evaluations.rationale: Specific context (start a round) and input method; not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Moderator view of all session items; similar to estimator view but actor differs (meaningful difference).

evaluations.evidence: select an item to be estimated or re-estimated
evaluations.rationale: Selecting an item for estimation is distinct from adding/editing/deleting items; no duplicate requirement found.

evaluations.evidence: add an item to the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Adds new item functionality; not substantially contained in any other story.

evaluations.evidence: edit an item in the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Editing items is a distinct capability from adding/selecting/deleting; no duplicate found.

evaluations.evidence: delete an item from the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Deleting an item is a distinct action; not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: show all estimates immediately
evaluations.rationale: Moderator-requested behavior to reveal estimates early; distinct requirement from showing after everyone has voted.

evaluations.evidence: accept the average of all estimates
evaluations.rationale: Specific decision rule (average) for moderator; not duplicated by other stories.

evaluations.evidence: "estimate" field filled in automatically if all estimators show the same card
evaluations.rationale: Specific auto-fill behavior based on unanimous cards; distinct from accepting average or entering agreed estimate.

evaluations.evidence: enter the agreed-upon estimate
evaluations.rationale: Manual moderator action to record agreed estimate; distinct from auto-fill or averaging behaviors.

evaluations.evidence: estimate a story we estimated earlier in the session again
evaluations.rationale: Re-estimation of earlier stories is a unique function and not duplicated by other stories.

evaluations.evidence: import stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: File import is a distinct mechanism from copy/paste; both are separate requirements.

evaluations.evidence: copy/paste stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Manual copy/paste is a distinct, narrower workflow than importing a file; not a duplicate.

evaluations.evidence: browse through previous games
evaluations.rationale: Moderator browsing games is distinct from viewing transcripts or scrolling within a current game.

evaluations.evidence: view a transcript of a game
evaluations.rationale: Viewing a transcript is a distinct capability from exporting transcripts in various formats.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a HTML file
evaluations.rationale: Export to HTML is a specific output format requirement; not duplicated by viewing or CSV export.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a CSV file
evaluations.rationale: Export to CSV is a distinct format for downstream processing; not duplicated by other stories.

evaluations.evidence: delete a game
evaluations.rationale: Deleting games is a unique administrative action distinct from deleting accounts or items.

evaluations.evidence: create an account for the application
evaluations.rationale: Account creation is a distinct requirement; other account stories cover different account lifecycle actions.

evaluations.evidence: log in using my account name and password
evaluations.rationale: Authentication/login is distinct from account creation/management and not duplicated.

evaluations.evidence: change my account details
evaluations.rationale: Account update is a different lifecycle action from creation, login, or deletion.

evaluations.evidence: delete my account
evaluations.rationale: Account deletion is a distinct operation and not substantially contained in any other story.

evaluations.evidence: see dates and times in my local timezone
evaluations.rationale: Locale-specific display requirement; not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: get a password reminder by email
evaluations.rationale: Password recovery via email is a specific requirement distinct from login or account creation.

evaluations.evidence: select whether to have the team estimate with {0, 1/2, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, etc.} or {0, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, etc.}
evaluations.rationale: Configuration of estimation scale is a unique business-rule requirement; not duplicated.

evaluations.evidence: invite up to 15 estimators
evaluations.rationale: A capacity/limit on invitations is distinct from the invitation mechanism itself.

evaluations.evidence: join a game by entering my name on the page I received the URL for
evaluations.rationale: Joining flow for estimators is distinct from invitation; not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: see the item we're estimating
evaluations.rationale: Participant view of the current item is specific and not duplicated by other stories.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we will try to estimate this session (estimator)
evaluations.rationale: Estimator perspective of session items differs from moderator's similar story (actor difference).

evaluations.evidence: immediately see that an estimate has been given by a specific estimator
evaluations.rationale: Indicator that someone has submitted an estimate differs from seeing values; not duplicated.

evaluations.evidence: be shown all estimates at the same time after all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: Participant requirement to reveal estimates simultaneously after everyone has voted; distinct from moderator-controlled early reveal.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate up until the last person selects a card and all are shown
evaluations.rationale: This requirement is substantively the same as PP-041 (both allow changing estimate until the draw is completed); no meaningful difference in actor, context, or goal.

evaluations.evidence: see each estimator's prior estimates for the story being estimated
evaluations.rationale: Request for historical per-estimator prior estimates for the same story is distinct from scrolling through prior rounds generally.

evaluations.evidence: see who gave what estimates during the current round
evaluations.rationale: Seeing identities with their estimates in the current round is distinct from an indicator that someone has submitted a vote.

evaluations.evidence: start a two-minute countdown timer that all participants can see
evaluations.rationale: Timer functionality is unique; related timer reset story is complementary but not duplicative.

evaluations.evidence: have the two-minute timer reset itself as soon as we all play an estimate
evaluations.rationale: Automatic reset behavior is a distinct requirement from starting the timer; not a duplicate.

evaluations.evidence: scroll back through the stories and estimates from prior rounds
evaluations.rationale: General navigation through prior rounds is distinct from viewing a transcript or individual prior estimates per estimator.

evaluations.evidence: always have the cards in the same order across multiple draws
evaluations.rationale: Consistent UI ordering across draws is a distinct usability requirement and not duplicated.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate as long as the draw has not been completed
evaluations.rationale: Essentially the same requirement as PP-034 (both allow changing the estimate until the draw is complete); no meaningful difference in actor, context, or goal.

evaluations.evidence: have a small thumbnail photo displayed near where my cards are played
evaluations.rationale: UI personalization with thumbnails is a distinct feature not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: site which is compliant with XHTML and CSS standards
evaluations.rationale: Standards compliance is a distinct developer-level quality requirement; not duplicated by other quality stories.

evaluations.evidence: have a list of definitions for commonly used terms
evaluations.rationale: Glossary/definitions is a separate documentation need and not redundant with other stories.

evaluations.evidence: have created database indexes
evaluations.rationale: Performance-related implementation task distinct from other developer stories.

evaluations.evidence: application function correctly in Internet Explorer 6 and 7, Firefox 1.5 and 2, and Safari 2
evaluations.rationale: Specific cross-browser compatibility requirement; distinct from general standards or accessibility stories.

evaluations.evidence: site comply with the W3C accessibility guidelines where possible
evaluations.rationale: Accessibility compliance is a separate non-functional requirement; not duplicated by other stories.

evaluations.evidence: have the application respond quickly to my actions
evaluations.rationale: General performance/responsiveness requirement not duplicated by other backlog items.

evaluations.evidence: be able to use Unicode
evaluations.rationale: Internationalization (Unicode) is a distinct requirement; not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: see sensible and predictable URLs
evaluations.rationale: URL structure requirement is unique and not substantially contained in other stories.

evaluations.evidence: have nice error pages when something goes wrong
evaluations.rationale: User-facing error page design is a distinct requirement not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: results to be stored in a non-identifiable way
evaluations.rationale: Privacy/anonymization research requirement is unique and not duplicated by other backlog items.

evaluations.evidence: be able to see some metrics on use of the game
evaluations.rationale: Analytics/metrics requirement (Mike) is distinct from other research or developer stories.
